retrievalProfile.description: A romantic, intimate composition featuring a close-up profile of a couple against a soft coastal background with expressive, hand-drawn script typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: An intimate mid-shot of a man and woman in profile, their faces nearly touching, set against a hazy blue ocean and beach background. The top third of the frame is dedicated to a mix of clean sans-serif metadata and a large, expressive, hand-inked script title with a drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: The couple's profile forms a central vertical axis of intimacy.
The dark hair of the subjects contrasts against the light sky and white clothing.
The expressive script title balances the weight of the photographic subjects below.
The horizontal horizon line provides a stable base for the vertical figures.
coreInvariants: The use of a hand-drawn, gestural script for the main title.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The couple occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The point of near-contact between the two faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold script title, moves down to the couple's faces, then follows their gaze/posture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third of the image (sky) provides space for the typographic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted blues and whites from the coastal setting and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the hair and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones providing a focal point.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a high-key, airy feel in the background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or highly saturated synthetic colors.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, gestural strokes mimicking a felt-tip marker or brush.
Variable line weight with visible ink-like texture.
Slanted to the right for a sense of motion.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended descenders and ascenders that overlap slightly.
Connected lowercase letters with disconnected capital initials.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, messy script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Subtle drop shadow on script text to separate it from the background.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the gestural, inked quality of the main title.
Matches the clean, functional look of the top metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus photograph of a man and woman in profile, faces inches apart, wearing white and light blue clothing, against a hazy beach and ocean background with a clear sky at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, hand-inked black script title in the upper center with a subtle drop shadow. Place small, all-caps sans-serif metadata text at the very top edge.

verificationChecks: Is the script title expressive and hand-drawn?
Is the couple in profile and centered?
Is the background coastal and soft-focus?
Is the metadata text clean and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the script's ink texture
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard digital cursive fonts; must look hand-inked.
Ensure the horizon line does not cut through the subjects' faces.

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color palette

postGenerationChecks: Verify script legibility despite gestural style
Ensure the drop shadow on text is subtle
Confirm the composition feels intimate and balanced
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate profile photography + Coastal soft-focus background + Hand-inked gestural script title = 70s Romantic Media Aesthetic
